name: DDE Core metadata properties
abstract: DDE core extensions beyond CDIF core: DDE resource type (from ResourceTypeCode), topic category keywords (from TopicCategoryCode), acquisition type keywords (from AcquisitionTypeCode), alternate names, and optional browse graphic images. Declares no conformance URI -- the DDE profiles that compose this block each pin their own https://w3id.org/cdif/dde/1.0/{profileName}. Defines properties: schema:additionalType, schema:keywords, schema:alternateName, schema:image. Uses building blocks: cdifCore (cdifProfile), definedTerm (schemaorgProperties), ddeResourceType (DDEproperties).
